title: Eleven Fathoms and One Dark Trench
subtitle: 海洋与水体 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 海洋与水体（自然生态·海洋与水体）
meta: 主题语境：海洋与水体（自然生态·海洋与水体）　|　核心词汇：deep　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 deep 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the pilot ① sounded a deep that no captain in the port would have entered, and he said the sounding was the whole of the passage. The ② deep, meaning the water and not the trench, ran eleven fathoms and stayed uncharted; the deep, he said, is the only thing in a channel that is judged by how long it is left unsounded.

Every ③ deep in that channel had the same dark trench beside it, and the ④ deep at the end, meaning the one they kept for the winter fishing and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever crossed twice. A deep, his mate said, is nine parts darkness and one part somebody willing to sound; the pilot said the darkness is the part that fills eleven fathoms.

The geographer meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the deep was the whole of the sea, meaning the depths and not the water. The ⑥ deep, meaning the depths and not any of that, is the only thing in a sea that everybody maps and nobody sees; deep, she said, is either something you sound or the only word that means both a water and a depth. She said the depth is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ deep had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the dark trench. The ⑧ deep of the whole thing, the pilot wrote in February, was one channel and eleven fathoms of sounding; deep, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sound. She said the sounding was never mentioned.

The ⑨ deep I remember is the one at the end, which was charted in 1972 and is still described as the darkest in the channel. A ⑩ deep, his mate said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being sounded; every deep, she said, is a depth that has agreed to look like a water. She said the depth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 深处的水域（指航道里出现的那一处）
B. n. 深水（指那片水本身，与那条海沟相对）
C. 固定搭配：sound a deep 测量一处深水
D. n. 深水（指留给冬季捕鱼用的那一处）
E. n. 深海；深水（抽象总称，指一条航道的全部深处）
F. n. 深水区（指海图上标出、被绘制的那一处）
G. n. 深处；深渊（指大海里那片不可见的深域）
H. n. 深渊（抽象总称，指人人测绘却无人看见的那片）

items.q: sounded a deep that no captain in the port would have entered
The deep, meaning the water and not the trench
the deep was the whole of the sea
the deep had become a line in a chart
The deep of the whole thing
A deep, his mate said in 1974

answers.why: sound a deep 意为“测量一处深水”，1949 年领航员测量了一处全港没有一位船长肯进入的深水。
deep 意为“深水”，指那片水本身而不是那条海沟，它深达十一英寻而未被绘入海图。
deep 意为“深处的水域”，指那条航道里每一处深水，每一处旁边都有同一条幽暗的海沟。
deep 意为“深水”，指留给冬季捕鱼用的那一处，是唯一有人穿越过两次的。
deep 意为“深处、深渊”，指大海里那片不可见的深域，地理学家说这片深渊就是那片海的全部。
deep 意为“深渊”，指人人测绘却无人看见的那片而不是那片水，是大海里人人都测绘、却无人看见的东西。
deep 意为“深水区”，指海图上标出、被绘制的那一处，到 1958 年这处深水成了海图上的一行。
deep 意为“深海、深水”，领航员二月写道，整件事的深水是一条航道和十一英寻的测深。
deep 意为“深水”，我记得的是末尾那一处，1972 年绘入海图，至今仍被说成航道里最暗的一处。
deep 为抽象总称，大副 1974 年说，一处深水是唯一会因为被测量而变得更好的东西。
